g.text: Catalog entity > Temporal tab > Workflow executions list > a Workflow ID > the details page of one run
Workflow type, Namespace and Task Queue are on the entity page; Search Attributes filter the list.
The Workflow ID is your business key.
The Run ID changes with every
Status, where the run stopped (the step it
failed at), Workflow type, Duration, Started.
Query...; Rerun for a closed run. A running
run also has Signal..., Update..., Cancel and
Events grouped into boxes: Activity, Timer,
Attempt: the result of the Retry Policy
Timeline: time waiting for a Worker, time running
Events: the Event History (Raw = as recorded)
